name: four-elements
label: Four Elements
description: 四象 — a draft-and-commit card duel whose rules live in the workbook as blocks and formulas

scripts.build: vite build && craftsmith build . && yarn copy-to-public
scripts.copy-to-public: rm -rf ../../public/four-elements && mkdir -p ../../public/four-elements && cp index.html ../../public/four-elements/index.html && cp dist/four-elements.js ../../public/four-elements/four-elements.js && cp dist/manifest.json ../../public/four-elements/manifest.json && { [ -f dist/tools.js ] && cp dist/tools.js ../../public/four-elements/tools.js || true; }

author: Jeremy He
